digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge reconciler and ticket store
propositions: bridge cannot currently support multiple tracker projects against one shared codebase; it hard-codes a single project in config, fetch JQL, and outbound mutation guards
one shared ticket store must own the project-to-repos mapping at .bridge_state/projects.json to prevent each repo from diff-ing other projects as remote deletions
each ticket records its synced project and belonging repos; absent project resolves to legacy default via idempotent ensure; explicit-empty project prevents outbound sync
multi-project fetch must iterate configured project set for base JQL and all three enrichment passes (parent, comment, issuelink), merging results by issue into shared snapshot
outbound dispatch relaxes cross-project guard from single scalar to set membership; store-compat adds multi-project-bridge capability stamp when mapping holds >1 project
pre-feature stores need zero-event migration preserving tri-state semantics and byte-identical event count, with older binaries refusing multi-project writes as fail-closed protection
